subject: 2026 Renewal & Expansion - recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@acme.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: 2026 Renewal & Expansion - recap and next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of the call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of what we covered:
- Current usage: ~1.2B tokens/mo (production generation + embeddings for search) with peak-hour latency sensitivity on the checkout and search flows.
- Pain points: rising per-token cost on hosted endpoints, tail latency during batch ingests, and the need for stricter data controls for customer PII in logs.
- Goals: reduce unit cost by ~30% without degrading p99 latency; lock in capacity for predictable throughput ahead of Q3 product launches; ensure KMS-backed key management for logs.

Proposed expansion path we discussed:
1) Move high-volume generation workloads to Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) — estimated uplift of +40% capacity for the same unit cost after quantization and batching.
2) Keep low-volume, experimental workloads on Hosted for flexibility.
3) Add KV-prefix caching for search embeddings to reduce repeated token generation.

Open asks / follow-ups (action items):
- Marissa (me): share the usage report and preliminary proposal (attached).
- Lukas: provide a Sizing & Performance appendix for the Dedicated footprint and expected p50/p95 numbers.
- Rafael: draft an SOW and outline the migration milestones (canary -> scale).
- Jordan / Priya: confirm procurement timeline and if Acme needs an NDA/PO template.

Timeline we discussed: renewal target June 15, procurement decision in the next 4–6 weeks to hit that date.

Attachments: Acme-Renewal-Usage-Report-Apr2026.pdf, Redwood-Proposal-Acme-Q3.pdf (prelim numbers).

If that looks right I’ll follow up with an updated proposal and SOW by Thursday.
\Best,
\Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — very clear, appreciate the write-up. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: Priya is our procurement lead and expects to submit the PO by 2026-03-20 if we can get final pricing and contract redlines by 3/12.
- Security: we need explicit confirmation that Redwood supports KMS (customer-managed keys) and that logs can be configured to exclude PII; please include a short security appendix.
- Pricing ask: can you provide a side-by-side Hosted vs Dedicated pricing at the 1.2B token current baseline + estimated +40% expansion? We want to see the per-token delta and also expected monthly commitment levels for Dedicated (e.g., GPUs, vCPUs).

We’re excited about the Dedicated path — the performance improvements look compelling for our checkout flow. Priya — looping you in for procurement specifics.
